metadata.data_years: 2023-2025 matriculation data; Fall 2024 UC systemwide admissions
metadata.notes: UC Information Center source-school dashboard requires Tableau browser interaction for per-school UC applicant/admit/enroll data. Matriculation data compiled from school profile PDFs and public filings. UC systemwide data from UCOP fact sheets.
metadata.tableau_dashboard_note: The UC Information Center 'Admissions by Source School' page contains a Tableau dashboard with per-school applicant/admit/enrollee counts. The data is public but requires browser interaction to extract. We confirmed the Tableau viz URL is https://visualizedata.ucop.edu/t/Public/views/AdmissionsDataTable/FrAdmbySourceSchool embedded via iframe. The dashboard has 'Single high school lookup' with a search box. Automated extraction failed due to Tableau embedding v3 requiring full browser JS execution. Manual lookup: visit the UC dashboard, click 'Single high school lookup' -> 'Counts of fall freshmen by race/ethnicity', then search for each school name.

menlo_atherton_high.note: UC admissions data available through UC Information Center dashboard (requires Tableau browser). Parchment data suggests strong UC placement.

menlo_school_uc_analysis.interpretation: Only 11.4% of Menlo graduates matriculated to a UC over 3 years, despite UCs being among the best public universities. This suggests Menlo students overwhelmingly prefer private universities. Stanford alone (30) outpaces all UC campuses combined (49). The UC Berkeley + UCLA rate (6.5%) is lower than the Stanford rate (7%), which is remarkable given Stanford admits ~4% of applicants vs Berkeley ~11%.

castilleja_uc_analysis.note: Castilleja does not publish per-school enrollment counts, only lists of schools. All 9 UC campuses appear on the 2025 admitted list, suggesting broad UC success but unknown depth.
castilleja_uc_analysis.interpretation: With only 51 graduates, even a few UC enrollees represents a significant percentage. The school lists all 9 UC campuses, suggesting strong UC eligibility across the board.
